gaps.sentence: Send your ___ (APPLY) to the address below.
gaps.explanation: 'Your application' — the document you send; an applicant is a person.

gaps.sentence: The test measures your ___ (STRONG) in each skill.
gaps.explanation: 'Strength' is the noun; 'strengthen' is the verb 'to make stronger'.

gaps.sentence: The law needs complete ___ (REVISE) before it can work.
The ___ (DEEP) of the lake is unknown.
gaps.explanation: 'Depth' — noun from deep (spelling change: deep → depth).
'A tendency to do something' — noun from tend.

gaps.sentence: The committee's ___ (DECIDE) was announced this morning.
He was praised for his ___ (BRAVE) during the fire.
gaps.explanation: 'His bravery' — quality noun; 'braveness' exists but is rare; 'bravery' is standard.

gaps.sentence: The results of the survey were highly ___ (SURPRISE).
